ops.oldText: If not specified, Materials will be considered Type II Materials.
ops.newText: If not specified, Materials will be considered Type I Materials.

ops.text: e. IBM assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in the Type I Materials and in all work product created for Customer, and Customer owns that work product. IBM grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any IBM intellectual property embedded in the Type I Materials. Customer retains all rights in Customer Data, and no Materials are jointly owned.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We must own what we pay IBM to create, so we have flipped the unspecified-Materials default in Section 7(a) to Type I (Customer-owned) and added a short paragraph (e) with IBM's assignment, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any IBM IP embedded in Type I Materials, Customer Data ownership and no joint ownership. IBM's pre-existing works remain Type II and are unaffected.
proposal.summary: Default unspecified Materials to Type I (Customer-owned) and add IBM's assignment, an embedded-IBM-IP licence, Customer Data ownership and a no-joint-ownership statement.
